description.value: A cross-sectional structural MRI study examined cortical thickness, gray/white matter border contrast, and local gyrification index in early- versus late-onset regular marijuana users, testing whether current consumption and duration of use showed divergent morphology relationships by onset status.

spans.text: We examined cortical thickness, gray/white matter border contrast (GWR) and local gyrification index (LGI) in 42 marijuana (MJ) users.
